extracted.name: Air Fryer Grilled Cheese
extracted.description: The best Air Fryer Grilled Cheese recipe is easy to make, has the perfect texture, and only takes 10 minutes.
ingredient_lines: 4 slices thick slices of white bread*
2 slices sharp cheddar cheese (, sliced thinly)
2-4 slices Choose between: Swiss, provolone, American, Monterey Jack, Gruyere, Fontina or Havarti (, or your favorite melty cheese)
instruction_lines: Assemble: Butter the outsides of the bread slices and assemble sandwiches with cheese in the center. Use a toothpick to secure the sandwich together (if your bread is thin, the top piece will blow off during cooking).

Air Fry at 370 degrees for 5-6 minutes, flipping once during cooking. Total cook time will depend on the type of bread. Check on it periodically and continue cooking until it reaches your desired level of toasted. Remove toothpick before eating.
categories: How to make a grilled cheese in the air fryer
